race.comment: OVER SPRAY (3) has been racing in far tougher company lately and produced a determined victory over this track 3 starts ago. He is perfectly placed back in this grade, and with the advantage of the pole position, he will take plenty of pegging back. LIFE OF TREE (8) hit the line strongly when beaten only a half-length into third place at Gatton last start, and he now looks ready to peak. He maps to receive the run of the race from the pole position, and he can have the last say off a genuine tempo up front. CIPHERTEXT (5) continued her honest form with a solid third at this track, and if she gets the right run, she can give plenty of cheek at attractive odds.
